title: BGM-HAN: A Hierarchical Attention Network for Accurate and Fair Decision Assessment on Semi-Structured Profiles

bias_targets.methodology: The paper aims to mitigate human cognitive and procedural biases (such as anchoring and confirmation bias) in high-stakes decision-making by replacing vulnerable human judgment with a standardized, automated model (BGM-HAN). The evaluation primarily focuses on assessing the model's overall predictive consistency and performance (Precision, Recall, F1-score, and Accuracy) against ground-truth admission decisions, rather than explicitly quantifying bias reduction using specific fairness metrics.
